title: Chapter 40
text: 49 She had. It read: A street of light will screem, the black chariot of the Serpente will flayme, and a Queene wille sing quickfilveres songes no moar. Most of the family had gone along with Gelatly Device, who wrote a brief monograph in the 1830s explaining it as a metaphor for the banishment of Weishaupt’s Illuminati from Bavaria in 1785.
